//: IntelliSense for the whole wood_project tree. VS Code only reads .vscode/ at the
folder that is actually OPEN, so wood/.vscode/c_cpp_properties.json is ignored when
the workspace root is wood_project - which is why examples/*.cpp squiggled on every
include. This is the same configuration, addressed from the outer root.
compileCommands is the authority: every .cpp that CMake builds gets its real flags
from wood/build/compile_commands.json, so it must exist - run
includePath is the FALLBACK for files the database does not name: headers, and any
source added since the last configure. It mirrors the -I flags CMake passes.
The kernel is session/session_cpp - inside the session monorepo submodule, which is
the only checkout of it here (see README.md). '../src/session.h' in wood/examples
resolves through the session/session_cpp/src entry as session_cpp/src/../src/session.h.
Without that entry the kernel headers are unresolved even though the file compiles.
